Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:164448
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 35649 of 2023

Applicant :- Balveer Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Lavkush Dixit, Advocate apprised the Court that today he has filed his power on behalf of the
informant in the Registry of this Court, therefore, his name is not shown in the cause list.
2. Heard Sri Pankaj Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Lavkush Dixit, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State.

3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 120 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Saifai,
District Etawah during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members including his son i.e.
husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the son of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 28.11.2022 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for a car and Rs. 2 Lakhs and on 15.05.2023 informant received an information that his sister i.e. deceased was administered some poisonous substance due to which she died.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation of demand of dowry and torture made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and only being father-in-law of the deceased, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
He further submits that actually deceased committed suicide due to pressure of her miscarriage.

He further submits that during inquest applicant and informant were one of the inquest witnesses but at that time no objection was raised by the informant and after three days FIR of the present case was lodged and this fact clearly suggests that totally on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry FIR of the present case was lodged.
6.

He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that autopsy surgeon could not ascertained the cause of death, therefore, her viscera was preserved, therefore, it appears to be a case of suicide.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 20.06.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and his daughter-in-law died under abnormal circumstances within six months of her marriage in her matrimonial home but could not dispute the fact that during inquest, informant and applicant were present and both were inquest witnesses and FIR of the present case was lodged after three days and applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Although, from the record it reflects that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within six months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home but no specific allegation has been made against him in the FIR or in the statements of prosecution witnesses recorded during investigation.

Further, from the inquest report dated 15.05.2023 it appears that at the time of inquest applicant and informant both were present and both were inquest witnesses but at that time no objection was raised by the informant with regard to torture and demand of dowry and FIR of the present case was lodged after three days i.e. on 18.05.2023

, therefore, I find force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that subsequently after three days totally on the basis of false story of demand of dowry and torture, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
10. Further, from the autopsy report of the deceased it reflects that her cause of death could not be ascertained and her viscera was preserved and doctor did not find and injury on her body.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant, who is father-in-law, is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant - Balveer Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
